rationale: BenchIO connects to the donor only through external USB 2.0; it does not consume undocumented POS462 internal rails or motherboard signals.
Therefore exact donor acceptance is required for finished-system integration evidence, not for standalone BenchIO schematic design and bench verification.
This removes an unnecessary serial dependency while preserving the physical-evidence boundary.

host_interface.power: USB 5 V powers host-side MCU/logic only; it does not power the active RS-485/CAN/output field domain
host_interface.pre_enumeration_rule: host-side design allocation must remain below the USB 2.0 pre-configuration 100 mA budget; field-side power is independent

selection_basis: six USART-class interfaces in the family

field_isolation.topology: galvanic isolation is provided by ISO1410 x2, ISO1042, ISO6740, and ISO1212 barriers; the shared field-side logic domain is powered from the external 9-30 V field supply rather than from USB

rejected_power_route.reason: 2 W / 5 V / 400 mA output does not close the conservative simultaneous field-side load budget (411.2 mA before margin). A larger USB-powered isolated converter would also make the USB power budget unnecessarily tight.
evidence: ISO1410 max 160 mA bus-side at 5 V, 500 kbps, 54 ohm load
ISO1042 max 73.4 mA side-2 in dominant state at 60 ohm load
ISO6740 max 17.8 mA side-2 at 5 V / 50 Mbps stress case

rs485.protection: TVS + connector-side surge/ESD network frozen during schematic
TVS + connector-side surge/ESD network frozen during schematic

digital_inputs.note: Use ISO1212 as a design basis for 24 V industrial-style inputs; PF-002 does not claim IEC certification.

digital_outputs.implementation: TPS4H160-Q1 high-side switch behind ISO6740 four-forward-channel digital isolation
digital_outputs.isolated_control: ISO6740 4-forward barrier into shared field domain
digital_outputs.baseline_diagnostics: hardware protection only; isolated current-sense/fault telemetry deferred from v0

economics.reason: Adds explicit host/field isolation architecture and robust 24 V digital I/O while retaining the PF-002 gross-margin floor.

price_observations.note: ISO1042 selected for isolation; current exact distributor price must be refreshed at sourcing.

economics.boundary: Distributor observations are screening prices, not production quotes. Exact assembly BOM and landed cost must be recomputed after schematic/PCB freeze.

remaining_before_schematic_freeze: exact USB-C receptacle and USB ESD device
ISO1212 threshold resistor network for the 18-30 V product window
TPS4H160 current-limit resistor and field-power protection network
system_integration_gate: one real POS462/B91 donor record with simulated=false
USB enumeration on that exact donor
finished-unit receipt binding donor serial + BenchIO hardware revision + firmware hash + OS image hash

design_corrections.issue: ISO6741 provides only 3 forward + 1 reverse channel, insufficient for four independent high-side output controls.
design_corrections.correction: Use ISO6740 4-forward variant for DO0-DO3. Defer isolated TPS4H160 current-sense/fault telemetry from v0.

design_corrections.issue: USB-powered B0505S-2WR3 field converter cannot meet conservative simultaneous field-side worst-case current: 2*160mA ISO1410 + 73.4mA ISO1042 + 17.8mA ISO6740 = 411.2mA > 400mA.
design_corrections.correction: Power the shared field-side 5V domain from FIELD_9_30V using a 65V-class 1A buck (LMR36510 candidate). Keep USB power exclusively on the host side.
design_corrections.effect: Removes field-load current from the USB budget and increases field-side power margin while preserving host/field galvanic isolation in the signal barriers.
